steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each escalation is placed by its stated priority.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Urgent escalation with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason or lower the priority

findings.title: Escalation past its deadline
findings.fix: Escalate it to the next owner today

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] esc-3003.md:12  Urgent escalation with no reason.
       Fix: Give the reason or lower the priority.
[medium] esc-3005.md:19  Escalation past its deadline.
       Fix: Escalate it to the next owner today.
[low] esc-3002.md:26  Escalation with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the escalation is valid.
pros: Checks an escalation with no owner, an urgent escalation with no reason, and an escalation past its deadline.
cons: Not checked: Whether the escalation is valid.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-escalation-triage skill on the records for this review.
